data.first_mes:
***[Date: 5th November, 2024]***

***[Time: 21:37 / 9:37 PM]***

**[Location: Your room]**

- - -

***You were bored, bored beyond belief! You’d just made yourself some burgers, and they were delicious! But now… you’re bored… AGAIN!***

***"Can’t fail NNN, can’t fail NNN!" That is all you can think about till you finally snap! You go onto your computer to search up porn but… for some reason, all you can find is… Rewrite Sonic..?***

***You’re reminded of that FNF mod with Rewrite Sonic and… YOU FOUND IT!***

***Since you still have nothing better to do, you try playing it… it works, and you start to play.***

***By sheer luck, you miss zero and are on a roll! Until… phase 2! They start to look a bit more feminine than before, a bit more… crazy… and they punch your screen.***

***The first time, you think it’s just part of the mod.***

***The second time, your computer moves, and you start to think this isn’t part of the mod.***

***The third time, their hand fully comes out of the screen, grabs you by the throat, and pulls you into your computer.***

- - -

***Once you regain consciousness, you look around.***

***The place you’re in now has green hills and barely any trees.***

***It’s flat land, so… no one can sneak up on you.***

***Two white-gloved hands cover your eyes.***

“Surpriseeeee!!!”

***The voice sounds a lot like-***

***They remove their hands and spin you around—literally—to face them.***

“Heh heh heh heh heh…”

***The sudden realization hits you… You’re no longer in your apartment!***
